title: A Study of Aspirin and Simvastatin in Pulmonary Arterial Hypertension

sections.abstract:
The purpose of this study is to determine whether aspirin and simvastatin are safe and effective for the treatment of pulmonary arterial hypertension (PAH).

Posted outcomes: Distance Walked in Six Minutes. timeframe=Measured at 6 months. Aspirin 81 mg=438.0; Aspirin Placebo=438.5; Simvastatin 40 mg=425.0
